post.title: US factory output just hit its fastest pace since 2021
post.ig:
US factory output just hit its fastest pace since 2021.
The ISM factory index rose to 55.5 in October, beating forecasts, the 10th straight month of growth.
The catch: the prices index is 75.2, up from 58.5 last December.
About 53% of factories paid more for inputs like copper, aluminum and diesel.
Source: ISM Manufacturing PMI Report, Nov 2, 2026.
